nodes.label: Šolski App (OŠ Toneta Čufarja Jesenice)
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Design principles: simplicity, maintainability and transparency — the author will not be at the school forever, so the app must be operable by anyone familiar with computers.

nodes.label: Application Description
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Every technology and feature is justified with a plain-language rationale because the app must be maintainable by whoever replaces the author; simplicity, maintainability and transparency are the stated design principles.

nodes.label: HA Architecture Documentation
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Explains why each HA choice exists (one replica per node, CNPG failover, etcd quorum caveats) rather than just what to run, so a future admin can reason about node failures instead of memorizing commands.

nodes.label: Main Documentation (entry point)
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the single entry point linking all sub-documents; deliberately written for non-experts (ELI5 style) so the system stays maintainable after the original author leaves the school.

nodes.label: Summer Shutdown Guide
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: The strict shutdown order (app → DB → Longhorn detach → power off) is a deliberate design decision: stopping in the wrong order can corrupt data, and the laptops are old hardware that should be hibernated, not deleted.

nodes.label: K3s Setup — šolski app
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Priporočena namestitev brez Dockerja (uvicorn): Docker build lahko pade zaradi tmpfs overload na omejenih računalnikih; neposredna namestitev je bolj predvidljiva.

nodes.label: Poletna pavza — k3s cluster
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Letni izklop: manj obratovanja = manj obrabe in daljša življenjska doba starih prenosnikov; manj porabe elektrike; manj tveganja ob poletnih nevihtah. Nič se ne briše — samo ustavi (kot zimsko spanje).

nodes.label: Local App Setup Documentation (EN)
nodes.author: Matej Čušin
nodes.rationale: Local install keeps everything on one machine: SQLite single-file DB needs no server, uvicorn is recommended over Docker on machines with small tmpfs; Docker still offered for parity with production.

nodes.label: Main app page (SPA)
nodes.rationale: All CSS and JS are intentionally inlined in a single HTML file so installation is simple and there are no separate .css/.js files to maintain; an inactivity timer auto-logs-out users for security.

nodes.label: Login page
nodes.rationale: Login, forgot-password and reset flows are sections of the same page (SPA behaviour without full reloads); client-side password-match validation is UX only and the server re-validates.

nodes.label: Test dependencies (requirements-dev.txt)
nodes.rationale: Test dependencies intentionally kept separate from production dependencies so CI and local test runs do not pollute the production environment.

nodes.label: Production dependencies (requirements.txt)
nodes.rationale: uharfbuzz in fonttools are added for emoji rasterization in PDF output to work around the WeasyPrint CBDT rendering bug (comment in requirements.txt).

nodes.label: Audit log
nodes.rationale: A chronological record of creations/deletions of reservations, series, assessments and blocked dates; visible to admin only.

nodes.label: BASE_URL (app config)
nodes.rationale: The app needs its full public URL to build email links and redirects; a wrong or missing BASE_URL would produce broken localhost links in emails.

nodes.label: Blocked dates (activity days)
nodes.rationale: Management marks days when nothing may be scheduled (excursions, sports days); the system auto-deletes conflicting assessments and emails affected teachers.

nodes.label: Blocked dates (management)
nodes.rationale: Blocking a period automatically deletes conflicting assessments and emails affected teachers, so management does not have to send memos and users cannot reserve on days with no school.

nodes.label: Cloudflare (proxy/DNS)
nodes.rationale: Flexible SSL: HTTPS between user and Cloudflare, HTTP inside the trusted school network (traffic never leaves it) — end-to-end TLS was deemed unnecessary here.

nodes.label: CloudNativePG (CNPG)
nodes.rationale: CNPG operator acts as a watchman for the database: automatic failover with failoverDelay=30s, enablePDB=true and podAntiAffinity — no custom failover scripts.

nodes.label: Daily cluster status report (cron)
nodes.rationale: If one node dies the app keeps working but nobody notices — the daily report flags the degraded node before the second one fails too.

nodes.label: Daily database backup (cron)
nodes.rationale: pg_dump emailed every night at 04:00, when nobody uses the app, so the backup is consistent — worst case loses one day of data.

nodes.label: Local deployment (uvicorn)
nodes.rationale: Simplest mode, installed in 5 minutes, data in a SQLite file on the same disk — but a single point of failure (if the PC or disk dies, everything is gone).

nodes.label: mDNS deployment (sola.local)
nodes.rationale: App runs on one server but is reachable by name (sola.local) without remembering an IP — still a single point of failure, recommended for smaller schools.

nodes.label: etcd (embedded k3s state)
nodes.rationale: k3s uses embedded etcd for cluster state; with 2 nodes, writes need confirmation from both — technically risky but acceptable for this use case (no SLA).

nodes.label: CSV export
nodes.rationale: CSV export of reservations and assessments is for management/admin reports — the links are hidden unless the user has permission.

nodes.label: Home economics classroom
nodes.rationale: Same principle as the computer room — one reservation per hour.

nodes.label: Hermes Agent (AI CLI)
nodes.rationale: AI CLI assistant used for maintenance and for generating documentation; always available and familiar with the codebase 24/7.

nodes.label: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
nodes.rationale: Autoscaling based on CPU (60%) and memory (70%): 2 replicas at rest, 3–4 during high load (start of school year).

nodes.label: Ladja (washing boat)
nodes.rationale: Special appliance for practical lessons — one reservation per time slot, same principle as other rooms.

nodes.label: Local mode (uvicorn/Docker, single machine)
nodes.rationale: Kept as the simplest option for testing or small schools even though it is a single point of failure — good enough for a staff-room deployment.

nodes.label: Longhorn distributed storage
nodes.rationale: Replica count fixed at 2 because there are exactly 2 nodes — a third copy is physically impossible; each node needs a dedicated non-system disk so it can run independently.

nodes.label: mDNS mode (sola.local, single server)
nodes.rationale: The recommended middle ground: no IPs to remember and no Kubernetes, but still a single point of failure.

nodes.label: MetalLB
nodes.rationale: MetalLB (Layer2) advertises the fixed LoadBalancer IP; if a node dies the IP migrates automatically to the other node, so users never notice.

nodes.label: Assessment schedule
nodes.rationale: Rules enforced by the system: max 3 assessments per week, max 2 regular ones per week, and no assessment on three consecutive days — so students never write 5 tests in one day.

nodes.label: Assessment scheduling (max 3/week, max 2 regular)
nodes.rationale: Rules are enforced automatically because they come from the law (max assessments per week), replacing the old sticky-note and whiteboard process.

nodes.label: Password reset
nodes.rationale: Users get an emailed link to reset their password — because everyone forgets a password sometimes.

nodes.label: Computer room
nodes.rationale: Rooms are physical spaces — only one reservation per hour (first come, first served).

nodes.label: Room reservations
nodes.rationale: Solves 'who is where when' — real-time view of free/taken slots instead of paper notes on the staff-room board.

nodes.label: Recurring reservation series
nodes.rationale: Weekly and full-day series let management create many repeated reservations at once (e.g. every Monday first hour in the computer room); available only to vodstvo/admin.

nodes.label: sola-db (CNPG PostgreSQL cluster)
nodes.rationale: Streaming replication mirrors every write to the replica; an RPO of a few seconds is accepted. WAL and data use separate PVCs because their I/O profiles differ.

nodes.label: sola-db-2 (REPLICA)
nodes.rationale: Asynchronously mirrors the primary; after failover it becomes the new primary and accepts writes — no manual intervention needed.

nodes.label: sola-db-rw (database service)
nodes.rationale: The rw service always points to the current primary and the app uses it exclusively via DATABASE_URL, so the app never needs to know which node is primary.

nodes.label: SQLite (development)
nodes.rationale: SQLite used during development because it is lighter and needs no server; PostgreSQL is used in production.

nodes.label: Tablets (28 units)
nodes.rationale: Tablets are physical items — capacity is divisible, so several teachers may share the same hour (max 28 units total, enforced by the UI and API).

nodes.label: Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS
nodes.rationale: Ubuntu Server chosen over Desktop: fewer packages mean more RAM for the app and a smaller attack surface for attackers.

nodes.label: CronJob sola-db-backup (dnevni pg_dump)
nodes.rationale: Email backup izbran, ker je zanesljiv in preprost — vsak zna odpreti email; ob 04:00 pošlje pg_dump celotne baze na BACKUP_EMAIL.

nodes.label: PVC sola-postgresql (5Gi)
nodes.rationale: 5Gi zadostuje za celotno šolsko leto — PostgreSQL je učinkovit s prostorom, cela baza za leto dela bo verjetno pod 1GB.

nodes.label: PVC sola-postgresql-wal (2Gi)
nodes.rationale: Ločena PVC-ja omogočata različne I/O profile — WAL je zaporedno pisanje (hitro), podatki naključni dostopi; omogočata ločeni backup strategiji (WAL arhiviran sproti, podatki periodično snapshottani).

nodes.label: Installation Decision Guide Diagram (SVG)
nodes.rationale: The decision gate is deliberately coarse (one machine vs 2+ machines) to steer non-experts; even a 1-node k3s is recommended over local mode for a real deployment.

nodes.label: CloudNativePG (CNPG) operator
nodes.rationale: Operator deluje kot 'robot-vzdrževalec' — sam skrbi za bazo: varnostne kopije, replikacijo, failover.

nodes.label: etcd (spomin clustra)
nodes.rationale: etcd hrani vse stanje clustra; zato je repliciran na oba noda — če etcd izgine, cluster ne ve, kdo je in kaj dela.

nodes.label: k3s-1 (HP ProBook 455 G5, 16GB RAM)
nodes.rationale: Oba noda sta control-plane, ker je pri 2 nodih škoda, da eden samo odloča — oba lahko poganjata aplikacije in oba prevzameta vodenje, če eden izpade. Več RAM-a na primarnem nodu zaradi PG cache/WAL bufferjev.

nodes.label: k3s-2 (HP ProBook 450 G5, 8GB RAM)
nodes.rationale: Oba noda sta control-plane — oba lahko poganjata aplikacije in prevzameta vodenje, če eden izpade (HA).

nodes.label: Longhorn (distribuiran disk)
nodes.rationale: ReplicaCount=2 (1 kopija = brez zaščite, 3 za 2 noda fizično ne gre) + replicaSoftAntiAffinity, da replike raje ležijo na različnih nodih — če en node crkne, podatki ostanejo.

nodes.label: MetalLB (LoadBalancer)
nodes.rationale: Kubernetes sam ne dodeljuje zunanjih IP-jev iz fizičnega omrežja — MetalLB to omogoča (dodeli zunanji IP aplikacijam). Traefik in k3s ServiceLB sta izklopljena, da se ne kregata z MetalLB za iste servise.

nodes.label: Kustomize overlay production-lb
nodes.rationale: Kustomize omogoča osnovno konfiguracijo + overlay za vsako okolje (dev, staging, production); production-lb doda MetalLB LoadBalancer.

nodes.label: k3s ServiceLB (onemogočen)
nodes.rationale: Onemogočen, ker bi se k3s ServiceLB in MetalLB kregala za iste servise — MetalLB ne bi dobil IP-ja.

nodes.label: Traefik (onemogočen)
nodes.rationale: Onemogočen (--disable=traefik), ker ga ne rabimo — zunanje IP-je dodeljuje MetalLB.

nodes.label: Audit log (dnevnik sprememb)
nodes.rationale: Append-only in nespremenljiv — revizijska sled mora ostati tudi, če admin zbriše uporabnika; vodstvo do njega pride prek povezave s tokenom.

nodes.label: Cloudflare (DNS/SSL/proxy)
nodes.rationale: Vedno uporabljaj Cloudflare proxy (oranžni oblak) — daje brezplačen SSL, DDoS zaščito in skrije pravi IP; DNS-only bi javno razkril LB_IP.

nodes.label: CronJob sola-daily-report (dnevno poročilo)
nodes.rationale: Dnevno poročilo ob 04:00 — preveri stanje nodov, Longhorn replik in aplikacije, da se težave odkrijejo pred uporabniki.

nodes.label: Visoka razpoložljivost — potek ob izpadu
nodes.rationale: Sistem zdrži izpad kateregakoli računalnika brez izgube podatkov; aplikacija nedosegljiva največ 1–2 minuti (30s failover delay + ~30s promocija + k3s node timeout).

nodes.label: sola-secrets (Kubernetes Secret)
nodes.rationale: V produkciji bi uporabili --from-file ali Azure Key Vault / HashiCorp Vault, za šolsko aplikacijo pa so --from-literal vrednosti dovolj.

nodes.label: Coolify (self-hosted PaaS)
nodes.rationale: Odprta koda, full kontrola, ni vendor lock-in, podatki ostanejo v EU/SLO — ampak OS in backup baze je treba vzdrževati sam.

nodes.label: Docker Compose na VPS
nodes.rationale: Najcenejša opcija (~€7/mesec) in zelo preprosta, ampak vsak deploy je ročen (ali pa GitHub Action + SSH) — če si na dopustu in crkne, nihče ne redeploya.

nodes.label: Managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE)
nodes.rationale: Ni smiselno: plačaš več (~€50–100/mesec) kot vse druge opcije, imaš več dela in za eno šolsko aplikacijo je to 'topovska cev na muho'. Longhorn v cloudu ne dela (rabiš EBS/disk).

nodes.label: Railway.app (PaaS)
nodes.rationale: Najboljši fit za najmanj dela: samodejni deploy ob git push, managed Postgres (backupi, PITR), avtomatski HTTPS/SSL, 0 vzdrževanja infrastrukture, ~€10–15/mesec.

nodes.label: Serverless (AWS Lambda / Cloud Run)
nodes.rationale: Ni idealno, ker app ni pisan za serverless arhitekturo — cold start zakasnitve, težje debugiranje; FastAPI + Mangum adapter je možen, ampak več dela kot Railway.

nodes.label: Ocenjevanje / napoved pisnih testov
nodes.rationale: Sistem samodejno preverja pravila (max 1 test/dan, max 2 običajna testa/teden, max 3 ocenjevanja/teden) za razrede 1.–7.; za 8.–9. razred pravil ne preverja, ker so skupinsko-razredne oznake.

nodes.label: Prostori (računalnica, ladja, tablice, gospodinjska)
nodes.rationale: Tablice dovoljujejo več sočasnih rezervacij (skupaj max 28), ostali prostori samo eno rezervacijo na termin.

nodes.label: Izvoz podatkov v CSV
nodes.rationale: CSV uporablja podpičje (;) kot ločilo, kar Excel v slovenščini samodejno prepozna.

nodes.label: scripts/import_teachers.py
nodes.rationale: Skripta samodejno prebere seznam zaposlenih s šolske spletne strani (https://www.tonecufar.si/o-soli/zaposleni/) — samo bere, ne spreminja ničesar na spletni strani.

nodes.label: Vloge (admin, vodstvo, učitelj)
nodes.rationale: Pravilna dodelitev vlog preprečuje težave in zlorabe: admin skrbi za sistem, vodstvo za urnik, učitelji za pouk.

nodes.label: Serijske rezervacije (tedenske/celodnevne)
nodes.rationale: Serijske rezervacije in zasedeni datumi so kot javni razglas — sistem sam obvesti vse prizadete učitelje z emailom.

nodes.label: Zasedeni datumi
nodes.rationale: Ko je dan označen kot zaseden, sistem samodejno izbriše obstoječa ocenjevanja izbranih razredov in obvesti prizadete učitelje — ni treba ničesar najavljati posebej.

nodes.label: Backup baze na USB
nodes.rationale: Zakaj USB? Longhorn ščiti pred okvaro enega diska, ne pred požarom ali krajo — če oba prenosnika crkneta čez poletje, je backup na USB edina rešitev.

nodes.label: Docker
nodes.rationale: Docker zapakira aplikacijo z vsemi odvisnostmi v zabojnik — deluje povsod enako, ničesar ni treba nameščati na gostitelja.

nodes.label: mDNS / avahi-daemon
nodes.rationale: mDNS omogoča dostop po imenu (.local) namesto po IP-ju, ki se lahko spremeni ob vsakem ponovnem zagonu.

nodes.label: SQLite (lokalna baza)
nodes.rationale: SQLite za lokalno, ker ne rabi strežnika — baza je ena datoteka (data/sola.db), ki jo kopiraš na USB in preneseš na drug računalnik; za testiranje in demonstracijo zadostuje.

nodes.label: Migracija v oblak — opcije
nodes.rationale: Priporočilo: Railway.app za najmanj dela (~€10–15/mesec, push-to-deploy); Hetzner VPS + Coolify za ceneje in več kontrole (~€7/mesec); Docker Compose na VPS za brez dodatnih orodij.

nodes.label: Cloud migration documentation
nodes.rationale: README states this file was 100% AI-generated by Hermes Agent and the author does not vouch for the listed prices/services — included as a starting point for discussion with a professional.

nodes.label: Cloud deployment (SaaS)
nodes.rationale: Easier alternative: the provider handles server, DB, backups and security for ~€7–15/month — no maintenance work; documented in migracija_oblak.md.

nodes.label: Linux Mint
nodes.rationale: Most 'Windows-like' option — if you can work in Windows you are immediately at home; light and works on old machines.

nodes.label: Local server from old PCs
nodes.rationale: Old PCs too weak for Windows 11 are reused as a local server: full control, data stays on-premises, no monthly costs; requires Linux/Docker/network knowledge.

nodes.label: Zorin OS
nodes.rationale: Even more Windows-like (the layout is identical) and light; Zorin Connect pairs with a phone.

nodes.label: CronJob sola-db-backup
nodes.rationale: Daily 04:00 Europe/Ljubljana, concurrencyPolicy Forbid so backups never overlap; env comes from sola-secrets via secretKeyRef.

nodes.label: ConfigMap sola-config
nodes.rationale: Holds non-secret app config (APP_HOST, APP_PORT=8002, BASE_URL, RAZREDI, PROSTORI, SCHEDULE) consumed via envFrom; secrets stay in the sola-secrets Secret.

nodes.label: CronJob sola-daily-report
nodes.rationale: Single read-only report combining k3s, Longhorn and node-lifetime heuristics; bounded by activeDeadlineSeconds 600 and runs under the sola-reporter ServiceAccount.

nodes.label: Deployment sola-app
nodes.rationale: 2 replicas minimum (HPA may scale to 4), rolling update with maxUnavailable 0 for zero downtime, podAntiAffinity spreads pods across hosts, and a 2Gi emptyDir tmp volume is mounted at /tmp for app temp files.

nodes.label: HPA sola-app-hpa
nodes.rationale: Scales up quickly (60s stabilization, +100%/30s) and scales down slowly (5min stabilization) to avoid flapping under school-day load spikes.

nodes.label: ClusterRole sola-reporter-readonly
nodes.rationale: Deliberately read-only RBAC (get/list/watch only, no logs, no destructive commands) as stated in the k8s README.

nodes.label: MetalLB Config (IP pool + L2 advertisement)
nodes.rationale: Provides the LoadBalancer IP range (193.2.171.200-210) that the production overlay's LoadBalancer Service uses.

nodes.label: Graphify Output Directory (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Outputs graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md and graph.json after 'graphify . --mode deep'.

nodes.label: Secret sola-secrets
nodes.rationale: Sensitive values (DATABASE_URL, MAIL_*) are never committed; created in-cluster via kubectl before deployment.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL (Production Database)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for production because it handles concurrent queries (30 teachers at once), has better security, supports replication and is the industry standard.

nodes.label: SQLite (Local Database Engine)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for local installs because it needs no server — the database is one file that can be copied to a USB stick.
